note: Showcaller Hub's list of apps, in the order it shows them; served as /hub/catalog.json by hub.js, which fills buildVersion and builds from the newest GitHub release tagged <id>-<version>. Updates come from /api/<id>/latest.

apps.name: Showcaller Screens
apps.blurb: Show control for the stage: video walls, cues, graphics and outputs.

apps.name: Showcaller Multiview
apps.blurb: Watch NDI cameras from anywhere, with tally and ATEM control (paid).

apps.name: Showcaller Timer
apps.blurb: Countdown and stage display, with a confidence monitor and producer page in Pro.

apps.name: Showcaller Replay
apps.blurb: Records every NDI source and plays any of them back as an instant replay.

apps.name: Showcaller ISO
apps.blurb: Records every NDI source to its own file at the same time, for the edit.

apps.name: Showcaller Playback
apps.blurb: Plays video, stills and sound from cue lists to NDI, and to SDI through a display output.

apps.name: Showcaller Switcher
apps.blurb: A 2 M/E NDI production switcher with keys, audio, media and recording.

apps.name: Showcaller Test Kit
apps.blurb: NDI test patterns and a receiver to check a network before the show.

apps.name: Showcaller NDI Webcam
apps.blurb: Turns a webcam or USB capture device into an NDI source.
